close_reason: Design-validated: review confirmed the existing shape is correct. No code change required. Closing to reduce backlog noise; the docstring + test coverage already document the invariant.
description: src/auth.rs:152-162, 200-212 — both fallible constructors validate header-value legality (HeaderValue::from_str), reject empty/whitespace tokens (RFC 6750 §2.1), reject colon in BasicAuth username (RFC 7617 §2). Stored as a fully-formed header_string. Result: auth_header() in the hot path is infallible — no panic, no Result, no per-request validation cost. A contributor might suggest 'why not validate lazily on first use' — the answer is: invalid credentials should fail at the test or startup site, not 30 minutes into a long-running session. Defend the fallible-constructor pattern.
title: BearerAuth and BasicAuth pre-validate at construction; auth_header is infallible
